latest_release.body:
# DeskBox 1.5.9

DeskBox 1.5.9 is a feature update: Windows 11-native right-click menus, a calmer and more capable updater, a recovery offer after configuration wipes, Korean language support, a clear notice on fully elevated desktops, and a wide reliability pass over widgets, drag-drop, and memory.

Released on October 23, 2026.

## Highlights

- **Windows 11-native right-click menus.** A single column of inline-icon rows in Explorer's classic order, rendered directly on acrylic; "Open with" lists real associated apps including UWP with icons; "New"/"View"/"Sort by" submenus on the blank area; native ZIP compress (tar variants, multi-select) and extract. Namespace shortcuts (This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel) inherit their target's verbs.
- **A calmer, more capable updater.** Daily wall-clock-anchored checks with failure back-off, actionable update-toast buttons, automatic release notes after an update, background downloads that skip metered connections with a ready toast, a stage-following status badge, version navigation across the full published history in the update log (identical on every machine, offline-readable once viewed), and an in-flight activity card in settings; background download and update notifications get separate switches.
- **A recovery offer after a configuration wipe.** When a launch detects missing settings plus a surviving snapshot that passes the hard gates, a one-time window offers restore-or-fresh; scheduled snapshots pause until the decision lands.
- **Korean language support.** The interface, installer, and first-run experience ship in Korean alongside the existing 12 languages, plus a full translation-quality pass over the 1.3.8-era machine translations.
- **A clear notice on fully elevated desktops.** A one-time startup notice explains why dragging out of widgets is unavailable when the whole desktop runs as administrator (UAC off, built-in Administrator, or company-managed), with the exact way back for Pro, Home, and alternate accounts; the drag-drop diagnostics attribute the same, and an acknowledged notice never returns.
- **The tray icon can be hidden.** A "Hidden" tray icon style: no icon at startup, immediate runtime switching, no revival on taskbar recreation.
- **Steadier widgets.** Placement survives display-topology changes, edge-docked bars stop jumping to a corner on reveal, group-tab capsules expand promptly on re-entry, revealing after hiding is prompt again, and the todo color submenu no longer crash-closes the app on Windows 11 25H2 (a font file 25H2 removed behind a leftover registration).

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the complete list.

## Downloads and verification

### GitHub Releases installers

| File | Architecture | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `DeskBox_Setup_1.5.9_x64.exe` | x64 | 32.15 MB | `3B8FAD94B8A0E0AE136572AE8DA378C72C406C7C370F875212CB71B8CB586E4A` |
| `DeskBox_Setup_1.5.9_arm64.exe` | ARM64 | 31.60 MB | `BA205202EDA7182BEBD282949C1DBA5EED87A0F4C682751285DA6E7D63A60A41` |

The direct installers are Full Native AOT builds with the bundled private Windows App Runtime — fully offline installation. Installers are currently unsigned. Verify the SHA-256 checksums after downloading.

### Microsoft Store upload

| File | Architectures | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `DeskBox_1.5.9.0_x64_arm64.msixupload` | x64 + ARM64 | 45.06 MiB | `F0D66275709A50ABB1B69D1D8D21B12080CB90D8A494F9682B3195D322D3B405` |

This combined `.msixupload` is the only file from this section intended for Partner Center. It contains `DeskBox_1.5.9.0_x64_arm64.msixbundle` plus the matching x64 and ARM64 `.appxsym` files. The internal bundle is version `1.5.9.0` and has SHA-256 `9ACD22C7CDCB7CA8440CFFA0205D8F308B2B8425916BC93EF95D83211DDE06FD`.

The two single-architecture `.msixupload` files produced during per-architecture auditing are intermediate evidence only and must not be submitted as the final DeskBox Store release.

# DeskBox **An open-source, local-first Windows 10/11 desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets and a declarative custom widget ecosystem.** English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Download](#download) · [Features](#features) · [Visual Experience](#visual-experience) · [Technical Overview](#technical-overview) · [Build from Source](#build-from-source) · [Licensing](LICENSING.md) [![CI](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?label=release&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) [![Windows 10/11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#technical-overview) [![x64 and ARM64](https://img.shields.io/badge/architecture-x64%20%7C%20ARM64-5C2D91.svg)](#download) [![License: GPL v3 | Commercial](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3%20%7C%20Commercial-blue.svg)](LICENSING.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/stargazers) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/total?style=flat&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases)
> **Contribution status:** External pull requests are temporarily paused while core architecture and extensibility boundaries settle. Bug reports, feature ideas, and technical discussions are warmly welcomed via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues) and Discussions — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ![DeskBox Windows desktop organizer with file, todo, search, weather, and music widgets](docs/images/brand/readme-hero-1-3-7-dark-en.png) Built on C#, WinUI 3, .NET 10 Native AOT, and a Rust native Shell layer, DeskBox adds a lightweight widget layer over the Windows desktop without replacing Explorer or moving your files into a proprietary database. Real-folder-backed file widgets make it a modern open-source alternative to tools such as Stardock Fences, complemented by clipboard history, a global search popup, todos, quick notes, Glance, weather, media controls, and programmable custom desktop widgets. --- ## Download | Channel | Package & Highlights | Link | | --- | --- | --- | | **GitHub Releases (Direct)** | Offline `x64` & `ARM64` Full Native AOT installers bundling a private Windows App Runtime 2.6, silent in-app updates, and companion-process UI isolation | [Latest GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) | | **Official Website** | Product overview, direct installer downloads, and documentation | [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun) | | **Microsoft Store** | Store-signed MSIX package with Store updates — ideal for supporting ongoing maintenance | [Get it from Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9PBZSNB4D69H) | - **Integrity verification**: Every GitHub Release installer ships alongside a matching `.sha256` sidecar file so you can verify package integrity before running Setup; see the [code signing and verification policy](docs/code-signing.md). - **System requirements**: **Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later** and **Windows 11 (22H2+ recommended)** on `x64` or native `ARM64` PCs. Installs per user by default and works fully offline. - **Release history**: See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the complete version-by-version history. --- ## Features ### 1. File Widgets & Desktop Organization - **Real-folder storage & mapping**: Create managed storage widgets backed by ordinary folders, or map existing desktop and disk folders in place without moving them. Migrating files into managed storage uses a copy-first, verify-before-commit workflow that never auto-deletes source files. - **Windows 11-native file interactions**: Single-column right-click menus with inline icons, Explorer-ordered items, real "Open with" app associations (including UWP), blank-area "New / View / Sort by" submenus, native ZIP compress/extract, and Spacebar [QuickLook](https://github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) preview. - **Multi-source drag-and-drop & stacks**: Drag files and links seamlessly to and from Explorer, WeChat, and browsers (including downloading remote URLs), reorder tiles manually, expand nested folder stacks inside widgets or Adaptive / 3×3 / 5×5 popovers, and drag files out safely even from elevated sessions. - **Widget groups & Desktop Organization workbench**: Combine file widgets into tabbed groups (connected tabs or equal-width tabs with `Ctrl+Tab` and wheel switching); preview rule-based routing before moving desktop files, enable automatic background filing for newly settled items, and review or undo organization history. ### 2. Everyday Productivity & Desktop Widgets - **Unified Global Search popup**: Connects over local IPC to an existing Everything installation (not bundled) and merges file results with DeskBox notes, todos, apps, and settings in one window — featuring an instant calculator, command palette, one-keystroke web fallback, and editable recommendations. - **Clipboard History & Quick Paste (`Alt+V`)**: Captures text, HTML/RTF, images, files, and color swatches with instant search, a keyboard-first `Alt+V` Quick Paste popup, offline image OCR text indexing, per-app exclusions, externalized large entries, and automatic local DPAPI encryption and UI masking for sensitive secrets. - **Responsive Todo & Quick Capture**: Adaptive single- and dual-pane layouts, task reminders, recurrence, color markers, a popout pinned note window, and live Markdown folder mirroring with linked or managed attachments. - **Glance, Weather & Music**: Glance displays date, weekday, lunar calendar, solar terms, and custom rotating backgrounds; Weather pairs MSN Weather with Open-Meteo fallback across four bundled icon packs; Music controls Windows media sessions with album-color ambience, audio spectrum visualization, and LRCLIB / local `.lrc` synced lyrics. ### 3. Custom Widgets & Widget Studio - **Zero-WebView declarative engine**: Renders native WinUI 3 desktop widgets from `manifest.json` without permanent WebView memory overhead. - **Air-gapped QuickJS script sandbox**: Interactive custom widgets can run `logic.js` inside an isolated QuickJS sandbox enforced by strict instruction-count, wall-clock, and memory limits. - **Studio ecosystem & Agent integration**: Includes curated official templates, AI prompt generation and repair flows, live diagnostics, `.dbxwidget` package import/export, `deskbox://` deep links, and a local `--mcp` stdio Agent bridge with mandatory **stage-and-preview confirmation** before applying desktop changes. ### 4. Capsule Mode, Native Materials & Multi-Monitor Memory - **Smart capsules & Quick Reveal**: Collapse any widget into a smart capsule or a unified movable capsule bar with hover-to-expand and collapsed text masking. Summon widgets via the tray, `F7`, double `Ctrl`, `Alt+Space`, desktop double-click, or custom global hotkeys. - **Native Windows styling**: Choose Mica or Acrylic materials, DWM rounded corners, custom per-widget icons and backgrounds, and material-matched, unified, or desktop-panorama global backgrounds. - **Hardware-aware multi-monitor memory**: Remembers per-display-topology arrangements bound to monitor hardware identities — unplugging a screen gracefully collapses or relocates its widgets and restores every position upon reconnect, immune to DPI scaling changes, sleep, or full-screen games. ### 5. Lightweight Native AOT Runtime, Backup & Reliability - **Isolated companion processes & low footprint**: Powered by `.NET 10 Full Native AOT` and a Rust native Shell layer. Settings and Widget Studio run in isolated companion host processes over authenticated named-pipe IPC and Shell thumbnails run out-of-process, reclaiming UI memory as soon as windows close alongside tiered idle working-set trimming. - **Resilient storage & encrypted backups**: Atomic snapshot writes protect settings and layouts from corruption, backed by scheduled local snapshots, optional domain-scoped personal WebDAV cloud backups (credentials stored in Windows Credential Manager), and one-click privacy-filtered diagnostic bundles. --- ## Visual Experience DeskBox adopts Windows 11 native materials and rounded geometry so widgets blend naturally into your desktop while keeping Explorer workflows intact. | Mica | Acrylic | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox desktop widgets with Mica material in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/云母材质.png) | ![DeskBox desktop widgets with Acrylic material in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/亚克力材质.png) |
Expand Settings screenshots (General / Appearance / Capsule / File Widgets / Feature Widgets / Shortcuts) | General | Appearance | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox General settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/常规.png) | ![DeskBox Appearance settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/外观.png) | | Capsule mode | File widgets | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Capsule mode settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/胶囊模式.png) | ![DeskBox File widget settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/文件格子.png) | | Feature widgets | Shortcuts & interaction | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Feature widget settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/功能格子.png) | ![DeskBox Shortcuts and interaction settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/快捷与交互.png) |
--- ## Technical Overview | Item | Details | | --- | --- | | **Supported OS** | Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later; Windows 11 (22H2+ recommended) | | **Architectures** | `x64` (Intel / AMD) and native `ARM64` (Windows on ARM) | | **Stack** | C#, WinUI 3, .NET 10 Full Native AOT, Windows App SDK 2.6, Rust native Shell layer, QuickJS sandbox | | **Data model** | Local-first; no account or mandatory cloud sync | | **Languages (13)** | English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Russian, Korean | | **Licensing** | [GPL-3.0-only](LICENSE) + [Commercial License](LICENSING.md) (dual-licensed) | --- ## Local-First, Privacy & Installation Notes - **Your data stays local**: No account required. Settings and widget data live under `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox\data`, and new managed storage folders default to a fixed non-system drive with ample free space (such as `D:\DeskBox\`) or `%UserProfile%\DeskBox`. - **Network calls are strictly opt-in / intentional**: DeskBox only accesses the network for weather forecasts, update checks, remote widget catalog (`catalog`) updates, user-configured WebDAV backups, confirmed remote URL imports, or explicitly submitted feedback diagnostics. - **Upgrades, privileges & safe uninstall**: Direct builds install per user via Inno Setup and preserve all settings and storage across upgrades. Launching elevated shows a clear Explorer drag-and-drop notice with a one-click normal-privilege restart. Uninstalling lets you keep or remove `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox` app data while **always preserving user files inside managed storage folders**. --- ## Build from Source Development requires **Windows 11** and **.NET SDK 10.0.403** (or a later `10.0.4xx` patch pinned in [global.json](global.json); Visual Studio with the Windows App SDK workload is recommended). Retail Native AOT builds and native Rust / QuickJS modules (`-p:DeskBoxRustNative=true`) also require the Rust toolchain pinned in [rust-toolchain.toml](rust-toolchain.toml) and Visual Studio C++ build tools (`VC.Tools.x86.x64` for `x64`, `VC.Tools.ARM64` for `ARM64`). Restore, test, and build `x64` Debug: ```powershell dotnet restore .\DeskBox.sln -p:Platform=x64 dotnet test .\tests\DeskBox.Tests\DeskBox.Tests.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal dotnet build .\src\DeskBox\DeskBox.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal ``` Publish retail Full Native AOT payloads via the authoritative script (compiles Rust / QuickJS native libraries, bundles private Windows App Runtime 2.6, and generates `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` for safe upgrades): ```powershell .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform x64 .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform ARM64 ``` Compile offline installers with **Inno Setup 6.5 or newer** (do not substitute bare `dotnet publish`, as the installer requires `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` to clean up retired files safely): ```powershell ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-x64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.iss ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-arm64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.arm64.iss ``` Expected outputs: ```text Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.0_x64.exe Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.0_arm64.exe ``` ### Project Layout ```text src\DeskBox WinUI 3 app, widget engine, Studio, companion hosts, and core services src\DeskBox.Updater Direct-channel updater helper native Rust native Shell / thumbnail proxy (deskbox-native / deskbox-thumbnail-proxy) and QuickJS sandbox (deskbox-qjs) catalog Remote custom widget catalog and AI prompt OTA rules (widgets.v1.json / prompts.v1.json) tests\DeskBox.Tests Service, contract, sandbox, and Native AOT guardrail test suite scripts AOT retail publish, native build, local dev, and catalog validation scripts installer x64 / ARM64 Inno Setup scripts and multi-language installer messages docs Architecture specs, requirements, code-signing policy, and visual assets .github\workflows CI build/test, ARM64 native gate, and distribution audit workflows ``` --- ## Feedback, Credits & Licensing - **Feedback & support**: Share bug reports or suggestions via the in-app **Feedback** entry, [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues), or [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun); see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md) for details. - **Special thanks**: [@magisph](https://github.com/magisph) for Brazilian Portuguese localization. - **Author**: Tianyu Zhu (朱天雨) · Repository: - **Dual Licensing**: Starting with **1.6.0**, DeskBox is dual-licensed under [GPL-3.0-only](LICENSE) and a [Commercial License](LICENSING.md) (independent `.dbxwidget` custom widgets are explicitly exempt from GPL copyleft, while DeskBox branding and official `deskbox.fun` endpoints are reserved; commercial inquiries: `1047078635@qq.com`). Earlier MIT and single-track GPL-3.0-only releases remain under their original licenses and are not changed retroactively. ## Star History If DeskBox makes your desktop cleaner and more enjoyable, a star ⭐ is a huge encouragement for this solo project. [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=Tianyu199509/DeskBox&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#Tianyu199509/DeskBox&Date)

# DeskBox **开源、本地优先的 Windows 10/11 桌面整理工具，提供原生质感的 WinUI 3 格子与自定义组件生态。** 简体中文 | [English](README.md) [下载与安装](#下载与安装) · [核心功能](#核心功能) · [界面预览](#界面与视觉体验) · [技术概览](#技术概览) · [从源码构建](#从源码构建) · [授权协议](LICENSING.md) [![CI](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?label=release&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) [![Windows 10/11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#技术概览) [![x64 and ARM64](https://img.shields.io/badge/architecture-x64%20%7C%20ARM64-5C2D91.svg)](#下载与安装) [![License: GPL v3 | Commercial](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3%20%7C%20Commercial-blue.svg)](LICENSING.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/stargazers) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/total?style=flat&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases)
> **贡献状态说明：** 项目处于高频迭代与扩展解耦期，暂不接受外部 Pull Request 代码合并，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues) 或 Discussions 提交 Bug 反馈与功能建议，详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ![DeskBox Windows 桌面整理工具，包含文件、待办、搜索、天气和音乐格子](docs/images/brand/readme-hero-1-3-7-dark-zh-cn.png) DeskBox 基于 C#、WinUI 3、.NET 10 Native AOT 与 Rust 原生层构建，在原生 Windows 桌面上增加一层轻盈的桌面格子，不替换系统资源管理器，也不改变文件原有的物理存储方式。以真实文件夹为基础的文件格子使它成为 Stardock Fences 等工具的现代开源替代；同时提供剪贴板历史、全局搜索弹窗、待办与随记、时光、天气、音乐控制以及可编程的自定义桌面组件。 --- ## 下载与安装 | 分发渠道 | 适用版本与特点 | 获取地址 | | --- | --- | --- | | **GitHub Releases（官网直装版）** | `x64` / `ARM64` 离线安装包，Full Native AOT 构建，内置私有 Windows App Runtime 2.6，支持应用内静默更新与伴侣进程隔离 | [前往 GitHub Releases 最新版](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) | | **官方网站** | 查看产品介绍、下载直装安装包与使用文档 | [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun) | | **Microsoft Store（商店付费版）** | 微软商店托管签名与自动更新，适合希望直接支持项目持续维护的用户 | [前往 Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9PBZSNB4D69H) | - **完整性校验**：GitHub Releases 每个安装包均附带同名 `.sha256` 校验文件，安装前可核对文件哈希；详情参阅[代码签名与校验策略](docs/code-signing.md)。 - **系统门槛**：支持 **Windows 10 2004（Build 19041）及以上** 与 **Windows 11（推荐 22H2+）**，原生支持 `x64` 与 `ARM64`（骁龙等 Windows on ARM 设备），默认安装到当前用户目录，可完全离线安装。 - **版本发布记录**：完整版本演进与详细更新内容请参阅 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 --- ## 核心功能 ### 1. 文件格子与桌面整理 - **真实文件夹映射与收纳**：创建由本地文件夹支撑的收纳格子，或直接把桌面、磁盘中的已有文件夹映射到桌面而不改变原文件位置；旧文件迁入托管存储采用“先复制、后校验、不自动删源”的稳妥流程。 - **Windows 11 原生级文件交互**：内嵌 Windows 11 样式单竖列右键菜单（含行内图标、「打开方式」真实关联应用、空白处「新建 / 查看 / 排序」与原生 ZIP 压缩/解压），支持按空格调用 [QuickLook](https://github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) 预览。 - **多源拖拽与叠放管理**：完整支持资源管理器、微信及浏览器内容（含远程链接下载导入）拖入与拖出、手动排序、格子内子文件夹折叠弹窗（自适应 / 3×3 / 5×5），以及提权会话下的指针跟踪安全拖出。 - **格子组与桌面整理工作台**：多个文件格子可无损合并为分组标签页（支持联通标签与等宽并列模式、`Ctrl+Tab` 与滚轮切换）；桌面整理工作台支持按分类与扩展名规则预览分流、自动后台归档新落盘文件及历史操作回溯。 ### 2. 日常效率与桌面组件 - **统一全局搜索弹窗**：通过本地 IPC 直连已安装的 Everything 索引并与桌面格子、随记、待办、应用及设置合并检索（DeskBox 不维护重复索引，Everything 需单独安装）；内置即时计算器、命令面板、网页搜索兜底与可编辑推荐区。 - **剪贴板历史与全局快捷粘贴（`Alt+V`）**：自动采集文本、HTML/RTF 富文本、图片、文件与色值，支持 `Alt+V` 全局快捷粘贴弹窗、本机离线图片 OCR 检索、来源应用排除规则、大条目外置存储，以及敏感凭据的本机 DPAPI 静态加密与脱敏显示。 - **响应式待办与随记**：支持单/双栏自适应布局、待办提醒/重复/颜色标记、随记独立置顶小窗与 Markdown 目录镜像同步，附件可关联原文件或托管复制。 - **时光、天气与音乐组件**：时光格子融合日期、农历与节气；天气内置 MSN 天气与 Open-Meteo 回退及 4 套内置图标风格；音乐组件接管 Windows 系统媒体会话，提供专辑氛围色、频谱动画与 LRCLIB / 本地 `.lrc` 同步滚动歌词。 ### 3. 自定义组件与组件工坊（Widget Studio） - **零 WebView 原生声明式引擎**：通过 `manifest.json` 渲染原生 WinUI 3 桌面组件，彻底摆脱 WebView 常驻内存开销。 - **沙盒脚本与安全边界**：交互式自定义组件支持内置隔离的 QuickJS 脚本沙箱（`logic.js`），受指令步数、运行耗时与内存配额硬上限保护。 - **工坊生态与 Agent 接入**：提供官方精选模板、AI 生成与诊断修复流、`.dbxwidget` 组件包导入导出、`deskbox://` 协议深链，以及基于 `--mcp` 标准输入输出的本地 Agent 桥接（外部变更经**暂存与预览确认**后方会应用到桌面）。 ### 4. 胶囊模式、原生材质与多屏记忆 - **智能胶囊与快速唤起**：任意格子可收起为桌面胶囊或组合成可拖拽胶囊栏，支持悬停展开、敏感内容隐私遮蔽；可通过托盘、`F7`、双击 `Ctrl`、`Alt+Space`、空白桌面双击或自定义全局快捷键唤起「快捷唤起层」。 - **Windows 原生材质与个性定制**：支持云母（Mica）与亚克力（Acrylic）材质、DWM 圆角、单格子自定义图标/背景图，以及跟随材质、统一图片和按桌面前后位置取景的全景背景模式。 - **按显示器拓扑的多屏记忆**：自动记忆每套外接显示器组合的布局并绑定显示器硬件身份，拔屏时自动收起或迁移、接回后逐格归位；DPI 缩放切换、睡眠唤醒与全屏游戏切分辨率均不破坏原有排版。 ### 5. 轻量 Native AOT 运行时、备份与可靠性 - **伴侣进程隔离与内存回收**：采用 `.NET 10 Full Native AOT` + `Rust` 原生 Shell 层；设置中心与组件工坊采用独立伴侣进程承载（通过鉴权命名管道通信），Shell 缩略图提取通过独立代理进程隔离，关闭窗口即刻回收界面内存，并配合分级闲置内存修剪控制常驻占用。 - **原子持久化与加密备份**：设置与布局采用可恢复事务快照落盘，支持本地定时快照与按数据域独立控制的个人 WebDAV 定时备份（凭据存入 Windows 凭据管理器），并可一键导出脱敏诊断包用于排障。 --- ## 界面与视觉体验 DeskBox 采用贴近 Windows 11 原生设计语言的材质与圆角体系，在保留普通桌面操作习惯的同时融入桌面背景。 | 云母材质（Mica） | 亚克力材质（Acrylic） | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox 中文界面的 Windows 11 云母材质桌面格子](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/云母材质.png) | ![DeskBox 中文界面的 Windows 11 亚克力材质桌面格子](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/亚克力材质.png) |

本地优先、隐私与安装说明 - **数据完全归属本地**：无需注册账号；设置与格子数据保存在 `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox\data`，新建托管收纳文件夹优先选在空间充足的非系统固定磁盘（如 `D:\DeskBox\用户名`），否则回退到 `%UserProfile%\DeskBox`。 - **仅在必要场景联网**：仅当触发天气查询、版本更新检查、远程组件目录（`catalog`）拉取、自行配置的 WebDAV 云备份、主动导入网络链接或明确点击提交反馈诊断时才会发生网络通信。 - **安装、权限与卸载保护**：直装版使用 Inno Setup 默认安装到当前用户目录，覆盖升级保留全部设置与数据；若误以管理员权限启动，应用会提示资源管理器拖拽权限限制并提供一键切换普通权限重启。卸载时可选择保留或清除 `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox` 应用数据，**用户托管文件夹中的真实个人文件永远不会被删除**。 --- ## 从源码构建 开发环境需要 **Windows 11** 与 **.NET SDK 10.0.403**（或 [global.json](global.json) 锁定的 `10.0.4xx` 后续补丁版本；推荐安装含 Windows App SDK 工作负载的 Visual Studio）。构建零售版 Native AOT 及 Rust / QuickJS 原生模块（`-p:DeskBoxRustNative=true`）还需要 [rust-toolchain.toml](rust-toolchain.toml) 锁定的 Rust 工具链以及 Visual Studio C++ 构建工具（`x64` 需 `VC.Tools.x86.x64`，`ARM64` 需 `VC.Tools.ARM64`）。 还原、运行测试并构建 `x64` Debug 版本： ```powershell dotnet restore .\DeskBox.sln -p:Platform=x64 dotnet test .\tests\DeskBox.Tests\DeskBox.Tests.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal dotnet build .\src\DeskBox\DeskBox.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal ``` 使用官方发布脚本打包零售版 Full Native AOT 载荷（自动编译 Rust / QuickJS 原生库、嵌入私有 Windows App Runtime 2.6 并生成升级清单 `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt`）： ```powershell .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform x64 .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform ARM64 ``` 使用 **Inno Setup 6.5 及以上版本**编译离线安装包（请勿用裸 `dotnet publish` 代替上方脚本，否则安装器缺少 `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` 无法安全清理旧版本载荷）： ```powershell ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-x64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.iss ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-arm64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.arm64.iss ``` 预期生成安装包： ```text Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.0_x64.exe Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.0_arm64.exe ``` ### 项目结构 ```text src\DeskBox WinUI 3 主应用、桌面格子引擎、工坊、伴侣宿主与业务服务 src\DeskBox.Updater 官网直装版更新辅助程序 native Rust 原生 Shell / 缩略图代理（deskbox-native / deskbox-thumbnail-proxy）与 QuickJS 沙盒（deskbox-qjs） catalog 自定义组件远程模板与 AI 提示词目录（widgets.v1.json / prompts.v1.json） tests\DeskBox.Tests 服务、契约、沙盒与 Native AOT 守卫测试套件 scripts AOT 发布、原生构建、本地调试与目录发布校验脚本 installer x64 / ARM64 Inno Setup 安装脚本与多语言词条 docs 架构文档、需求规范、代码签名策略与品牌截图资产 .github\workflows CI 构建测试、ARM64 原生门禁与分发审计工作流 ``` --- ##
